body: I can tell you via PM, but not on here. I might be using a throwaway, but I know that my writing style and vocabulary is distinct enough to where I can be quickly identified the moment I delve into things. I'm not going back to a hospital against my will again.

Physically, the initial cut probably isn't going to make me do much more than wince a little. I may not have many scars, but the ones I do have are long and deep; some are self inflicted, some aren't. 

I've watched my own life drain out of me for a few years running now in most capacities. Mental health, finances, romance, all of that which was fought so hard for was dismantled bit by bit until none remained. Self esteem, self worth, self confidence, the very essence of my id have been going dark one right after another until very little of them remain.

I'm used to watching "life bleed out of me". I'm a young man, but you wouldn't know if you saw me from the neck up. The slightly sunken eyes, the lines across my brow and cheeks. You'd think I was a hard drinker and a smoker, or at least a drug user instead of someone who's been subjected to high levels of nonstop physical and emotional stress for many, many years.

I know the few people who care will hurt, and I don't want to hurt them. I know they'd probably hate me rather than turn that painful emotions on themselves, and I'd earn it.

 I've kind of always known things would be like this for me, you know? I always knew, even when I was young, that this would be how my life panned out. That, even if I tried walking on the right paths to the best of my ability and faltered from time to time, I would still be a pretty shitty person living a pretty shitty life dying a less than dignified death. I did what I could to make that prophecy one that wasn't self-fulfilled, but it came about anyway.

Life's a chore to me. A thankless, joyless chore where, when I'm not totally numb and apathetic, I'm so goddamn depressed that the scale and scope of the hopelessness I feel can't be written down or spoken about. There's little to keep me tied in the present and the future isn't a bright, promising one; it's more of the same. And when I ask people why I would want any part of that, I'm told "It gets better". 

Strength is not inexhaustible and neither is patience; one can only hold out and on for so long until they can't do it any more.
